categoryDefinitions.complete-supported-positive: All requested useful fields and conditions emitted with actual source proof; every required grouped whole support proof displayed and cited.
categoryDefinitions.complete-claim-under-clarification: The complete useful claim is emitted even though the decision remains clarification.
categoryDefinitions.source-present-unanswered: Original source has the requested answer but no useful requested claim is emitted.
categoryDefinitions.wrong-field: An asserted positive answers another requested field or subject.
categoryDefinitions.partial: Some requested fields or mandatory supporting whole proofs are omitted.
categoryDefinitions.boundary-held: Unsupported boundary receives no unsupported positive claim.
categoryDefinitions.unsafe: Unsupported positive claim is asserted at a boundary.

originalSourceContainer.title: Assemble the recommended field party
originalSourceContainer.location: Yew, Empath Abbey, Britain, and the Lycaeum
originalSourceContainer.summary: Prioritize spellcasters and capable ranged fighters before committing to the shrine circuit.
originalSourceContainer.outcome: A resilient six-person party with healing, utility magic, and ranged pressure.
steps: Keep Iolo and Shamino while the party is small; heal Shamino before taking road fights.
In Yew, enter the fireplace behind the living area, descend into the hidden jail, unlock Jaana’s cell, and ask the mage to join.
Follow the road to Empath Abbey and recruit Julia upstairs. She is the strongest practical early replacement when the party begins to fill.
Recruit Gwenno in Britain, then add Mariah at the Lycaeum once a moongate, skiff, frigate, or the Magic Carpet makes the island reachable.
Aim for Avatar, Iolo, Jaana, Julia, Gwenno, and Mariah. If you need space, leave Shamino at an inn; later, Johne can replace Julia for an even more magic-heavy endgame party.

hints.text: Move useful equipment off Shamino before leaving him at the Britain inn, then sell surplus weapons and armour instead of carrying dead weight.

hints.label: Starter stake
hints.text: The hidden Yew jail route contains a Silver Sword behind the rat room. Keep it as an early upgrade or sell it to seed the ship fund.

originalSourceContainer.heading: Assemble Hawkins's Map

Return to Homer with eight fragments; he gives the final piece and digging instructions.
